# Document Q&A answer evaluation (generated; do not edit by hand)

Generated by `backend/tools/eval_qa.py` on 2026-11-17 with **openai/gpt-oss-120b** and local `BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5` embeddings over the three real sample documents (SEC filing as DOCX, its financial statements as XLS, an investor deck as PDF). Ground truth was read out of the files (`backend/tests/rag_eval_data.py`). The *held-out* questions were written after the retrieval settings were frozen. Single run, every question listed; LLM output is non-deterministic.

Cost at $0.15/1M input and $0.6/1M output tokens. Latency includes the rate-limit governor's pacing (Groq free tier, 8,000 tokens/min). "supported" uses the snippet shown to the user, which is a short excerpt, so it is stricter than "the whole cited passage supports it".
